data.Name: Friendly Ghost
data.Description: A translucent figure floats toward you, looking distressed. 'Excuse me, living person! I've lost my favorite sock! I've been dead for 200 years and this is somehow still the worst thing that's happened to me!'
data.Outcomes: [{"probability": 0.40, "type": "player_choice", "text": "The ghost wrings their transparent hands. 'It was argyle! Limited edition! They don't make them anymore because, well, 200 years!'", "params": {"choices": [{"name": "Help Find the Sock", "risk": 0.2, "success": {"type": "spawn_ally", "text": "You find the sock behind a tombstone! The ghost is so overwhelmingly grateful it pledges eternal servitude. 'I'll haunt your enemies! For FREE!'", "params": {"deck": "beta_npc_deck.json", "count": 1}}, "failure": {"type": "draw_card", "text": "You don't find the sock, but you find some lint, a lost button, and something vaguely useful.
